title: AI Auto Internal Link Suggester
description: Suggests internal links for a page. Give it a page URL and your sitemap URL; an AI model (Claude, OpenAI, NVIDIA, or any OpenAI-compatible API) picks relevant sitemap pages and proposes up to 2 anchor texts per target URL, taken from body paragraphs only (never headings). Irrelevant URLs are skipped.
